messages:
Priya (Sales): AuroraEdge wants a short perf POC before procurement. Targets: smoke 30 qps, sustained 150 qps for 20m, microburst 1k qps for 15s. Response ~128 tokens, p95 target <200ms, p99 <400ms. They asked for a cost ballpark < $1.2k. Can we confirm runbook and rough cost?

Ben (Solutions): Got it. Confirm model: 7B float16? Any requirement for CMK or audit logs? Single-region (us-east) ok?

Priya (Sales): Yes float16 7B, single-region us-east-1. KMS + audit logs requested but CMK optional.

Noor (SRE): Proposed runbook: 1) smoke 5m at 30 qps; 2) prewarm 8m; 3) ramp to 150 qps over 4m hold 20m; 4) burst ramp to 1k over 10s hold 15s; 5) cooldown. Telemetry: p50/p95/p99, instance count, GPU util, queue length, retries. Autoscale min=2 max=9. Abort burst if GPU util >85% for 30s.

Hana (Eng-ML): For 128 tokens recommend batching window 10ms and batching target 10-14. If they accept q4_0 quant variant we can reduce cost ~1.5x and usually improve p95/p99 — will run both variants. Note: prefix caching helps for templated prompts.

Leo (Security): I'll prepare a one-page sec note: TLS, KMS-managed keys by default, audit log snapshot. Confirm retention (default 90d, can do 30d).

Ben (Solutions): Cost sketch Hosted: with above plan expect ~$800-1.2k depending on soak. If they want guaranteed price below $1.2k we can trim soak to 5m and use quant variant for main run.

Priya (Sales): They prefer to see both float16 and quant numbers but want overall presentation < $1.2k. Can we aim for that and note caveats?

Noor (SRE): Yes — we'll set prewarm 5m for the cost-constrained run and keep max-instances=9 for headroom. PoolBot will create ephemeral pool and dashboard.

PoolBot: Ephemeral pool created: pool-id pcp-1769123456, region us-east-1, max-instances 9, dashboard /dash/pcp-1769123456. Logs retention set to 30d.

Hana (Eng-ML): Quick micro-sim (internal): float16 @150 qps -> median 52ms, p95 140ms, p99 310ms with batching=12. q4_0 @150 qps -> median 36ms, p95 90ms, p99 200ms. Bursts to 1k qps pushed p99 to ~450ms float16, ~300ms q4_0 when autoscale capped. CSV attached.

Ben (Solutions): I'll produce a one-page cost/ops note showing two options: conservative (<$1.2k) and thorough (~$1.6k). Priya will present the <$1.2k option and include the caveats.

Priya (Sales): Thanks team. Action items: Ben cost note (<12h), Leo sec one-pager, Hana attach request.json + CSV, Noor finalizes pool. I'll schedule kickoff for tomorrow 9am ET. :thumbsup:
